title: Microsoft launches Scout AI assistant for productivity software #Microsoft #Scout #ProductivityAI
description:
Microsoft released Scout, a new productivity tool built on the open-source OpenClaw agent that gained viral attention earlier this year. Scout integrates seamlessly with Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint, operating in the background to monitor projects, draft follow-ups, schedule focus time, and deliver proactive updates.

By embedding itself as a distinct identity within company directories, Scout functions almost like a new team member, enhancing collaboration and efficiency for businesses. This innovation could disrupt the $50 billion productivity software market by offering AI-driven assistance that anticipates user needs across multiple platforms.

Scout’s approach exemplifies the growing trend of AI agents transforming workplace productivity, helping companies gain a competitive edge through smarter automation and context-aware support.
